text: {"name":"mac_prepare_tx_frame","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Prepares a transmit MAC frame by updating interface protection state and assigning a sequence number to frames without a station-specific sequence context.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v5":"packet_length","v10":"frame","v15":"fragment_number","v16":"sequence_number","v17":"packet_flags","v21":"receiver_address_copy"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":82,"meaning":"Processing flags; this function sets bit 2."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Packet length."},{"offset":27,"meaning":"Station index; 0xFF selects the station-less sequence-number path."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Virtual-interface index."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"Packet processing flags."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Packet status flags; bit 0x200000 suppresses the main processing path."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to a context whose offset 28 contains the MAC frame pointer."},{"offset":0,"meaning":"MAC frame control field."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"First receiver/destination address in the MAC frame."},{"offset":22,"meaning":"MAC sequence-control field."},{"offset":26,"meaning":"MAC frame field checked as part of the four-address-frame condition."}]}
